records.jp: あ……<CR>金魚すくい、やりたい
records.en_original: Ooh, I wanna try goldfish scooping!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, I wanna try goldfish scooping!
records.en: Ah...<CR>Kirara wants to try goldfish scooping.

records.jp: ちょっと待って
records.en: Wait.

records.jp: おっけー。<CR>金魚たち、嫌がってない
records.en_original: That's good. It appears that the goldfish won't mind.
records.en_auxiliary: That's good. It appears that the goldfish won't mind.
records.en: All right. The goldfish<CR>do not dislike the idea.

records.jp: んじゃ、勝負でもしてみる？
records.en_original: How about we have a little competition?
records.en_auxiliary: How about we have a little competition?
records.en: How about we have a little competition?

records.jp: 勝負、する。<CR>愛央はその言葉、後悔するだろう
records.en_original: Very well. I'll make you regret those words.
records.en_auxiliary: Very well. I'll make you regret those words.
records.en: Kirara accepts the challenge.<CR>You will regret those words, Ao.

records.jp: 手加減なしだからね！
records.en: I won't hold anything back!

records.jp: その心意気やよし
records.en: That is the spirit.

records.jp: では、すくった数で勝負だ
records.en_original: The one who scoops the most will be the winner.
records.en_auxiliary: The one who scoops the most will be the winner.
records.en: The one who scoops the most will be the winner.

records.jp: おう！
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: えーと、お手柔らかにお願いします
records.en_original: Uh... Mind going easy on me?
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... Mind going easy on me?
records.en: Uh... Mind going easy on me?

records.jp: 勝負に手加減などはない。<CR>死ぬ気で、かかってこい
records.en_original: Absurd. I shall do no such thing. This is a fight to the death.
records.en_auxiliary: Absurd. I shall do no such thing. This is a fight to the death.
records.en: There is no holding back in competition.<CR>Come at Kirara as though your life depends on it.

records.jp: 熱血格闘漫画！？
records.en_original: What is this, a tournament arc or something?!
records.en_auxiliary: What is this, a tournament arc or something?!
records.en: What is this, a hot-blooded fighting manga!?

records.jp: ……よし！　やっと一匹すくえた！
records.en: All right! I finally scooped one!

records.jp: むう……！　きららだって……
records.en: Grr...! Kirara can do it too...

records.jp: おおっ！　きららも、すくえた！
records.en: Oh! Kirara scooped one too!

records.jp: １対１……面白くなってきた！
records.en_original: One to one, huh... I like a challenge!
records.en_auxiliary: One to one, huh... I like a challenge!
records.en: One to one... This is getting interesting!

records.jp: 勝利は渡さない
records.en: Kirara will not surrender victory.

records.jp: 私だって！！
records.en: Neither will I!!

records.jp: うおおおおーーーー！！
records.en: Raaaah!

records.jp: あー！　破れたあ！
records.en: Ah! My scooper broke!

records.jp: うぅ……きららのも
records.en: Ugh... Kirara's too.

records.jp: じゃあ、同点ってことかぁ
records.en: Looks like we tied.

records.jp: もう一回やる？
records.en: Want a rematch?

records.jp: いや、きららの腕はもう限界。<CR>これ以上やれば、腕が暴走する恐れがある
records.en_original: I'll have to decline. My arms are at their limit. If I overwork them anymore, I am bound to lose control of them.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll have to decline. My arms are at their limit. If I overwork them anymore, I am bound to lose control of them.
records.en: No. Kirara's arms are already at their limit.<CR>If she continues, they may run out of control.

records.jp: （つまり、疲れたんだな）
records.en: (Or in other words, you're tired.)

records.jp: 勝負は、次に持ち越しかな
records.en: We'll settle this another day.

records.jp: うん。<CR>次こそは、きららが勝つ
records.en: Yes.<CR>Next time, Kirara will win.

records.jp: 私だって、そのつもりだよ！
records.en_original: No way, I'm gonna come out on top next time!
records.en_auxiliary: No way, I'm gonna come out on top next time!
records.en: No way, I'm gonna come out on top next time!

records.jp: さーてと、そろそろ行こっか
records.en_original: Whew, shall we call it a day?
records.en_auxiliary: Whew, shall we call it a day?
records.en: Whew, shall we call it a day?

records.jp: ん？<CR>私の金魚が気になる？
records.en_original: Hm? Is there something wrong with my goldfish?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? Is there something wrong with my goldfish?
records.en: Hm? Are you<CR>interested in my goldfish?

records.jp: 愛央の金魚、キャリコ模様のバランスが<CR>すごくいい。もはや芸術の粋……<CR>
records.en_original: No, I was just thinking how its patterning is perfectly balanced. It's like the artistic ideal of a goldfish...
records.en_auxiliary: No, I was just thinking how its patterning is perfectly balanced. It's like the artistic ideal of a goldfish...
records.en: The balance of the calico pattern on Ao's goldfish is wonderful.<CR>It has already reached the height of art...<CR>

records.jp: （よくわかんないけど……<CR>この金魚が、気に入ったってことかな？）
records.en_original: (I'm not quite sure what she's talking about, but I think she's taken a liking to my goldfish.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm not quite sure what she's talking about, but I think she's taken a liking to my goldfish.)
records.en: (I don't really understand...<CR>but I guess she likes this goldfish.)

records.jp: 交換する？
records.en: Wanna trade?

records.jp: ……いや、いい
records.en: ...No, thank you.

records.jp: きっとこの金魚はご縁があって愛央の元へ来た
records.en_original: I am sure that fate brought you that goldfish.
records.en_auxiliary: I am sure that fate brought you that goldfish.
records.en: Surely fate brought this goldfish to Ao.

records.jp: きららの金魚も同じ
records.en_original: Just like it did with mine.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like it did with mine.
records.en: The same is true of Kirara's goldfish.

records.jp: そのご縁を無下にするのは<CR>神様にもこの金魚にも失礼
records.en_original: To disregard such fate would be an affront to the gods and to our goldfish.
records.en_auxiliary: To disregard such fate would be an affront to the gods and to our goldfish.
records.en: Disregarding that bond of fate would<CR>be rude to the Divine and to this goldfish.

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>そうだよね
records.en: ...Huh.<CR>You have a point.

records.jp: 私もこの子大事にしよっと
records.en_original: I'm gonna take care of you, little guy.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna take care of you, little guy.
records.en: I should take good care of this one too.

records.jp: ふふーん、いいでしょ！
records.en: Heheh, nice, isn't it?

records.jp: う……き、きららのだって可愛い！
records.en_original: Hrk... W-well mine's just as cute!
records.en_auxiliary: Hrk... W-well mine's just as cute!
records.en: Ugh... K-Kirara's is cute too!

records.jp: ほら、泳ぐ時の勢いが良い。<CR>立派に育つ証拠だ
records.en_original: Here, observe how strongly it swims. It will surely only grow stronger.
records.en_auxiliary: Here, observe how strongly it swims. It will surely only grow stronger.
records.en: Look at how vigorously it swims. That proves<CR>it will grow splendidly.

records.jp: ふふっ、さっそく親バカになってる
records.en: Hehe, you're already a doting parent.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
